name: Charlie
summary: Likely 'Charlie' — the middleman who passed Brandi's contact info to Eric, which is how the phone owner got this number (he opened annoyed that his number was being passed around). He is a broker/reseller for Instagram unbans: he was price-shopping several unban providers so he could mark them up and resell, and claims a friend who is 'head of partnerships of Instagram in Europe' who would do unbans off the books. Conversation ended amicably with an agreement to keep each other in the loop and split/mark up any unban work Brandi does; he said he'd call Brandi to vouch. He spends 3-6 months a year in Europe (in Europe since early April 2026, festival circuit), so expect delays and party-mode responses.
key_facts: Initially hostile about number being shared; smoothed over after owner explained he's Eric's rep
Connected to Brandi — says she trusts him but told him she 'didn't trust you guys' and didn't know the owner
Broker, not end client: shopping unban vendors for best price to mark up and resell
Claims a contact who is head of partnerships at Instagram in Europe doing under-the-table unbans
Owner agreed to tack margin on top for him if Brandi does the job
Said he'd call Brandi to vouch / align stories
Heavy Europe traveler: 3-6 month stints, 5.5 months straight last year, in Europe since early April 2026
Best friend's dad owns ~15 European festivals — gets in free; often unreachable at festivals
Sent an Instagram story screenshot (selfie) — white male, ~30s, dark hair/beard
services_discussed: Reseller pricing and markup on unbans
Referral arrangement via Brandi and Eric
